title: Keyboard Spacer E2E Verification - Task 4

test1_desktop_no_spacer.name: Desktop - Verify no spacer rendered
assertions: Spacer element does NOT exist (querySelector('.keyboard-spacer') returns null)
Terminal wrapper renders without keyboard-related sizing

test2_mobile_keyboard_open.name: Mobile - Verify spacer behavior when keyboard opens
assertions: Spacer element EXISTS in DOM after keyboard simulation
Spacer height > 0px when visualViewport shrinks (keyboard open)
No page-level scrollbars during keyboard open

test3_mobile_keyboard_close.name: Mobile - Verify spacer height returns to 0 when keyboard closes
assertions: Spacer height returns to 0px when visualViewport restored (keyboard close)
No page-level scrollbars after keyboard close

test4_orientation_change.name: Mobile - Verify orientation change without scrollbars

assertions: Spacer reserves keyboard height in portrait
Spacer adapts to reduced absolute height in landscape
No page-level scrollbars even with smaller viewport
Layout remains stable during orientation change

implementation_verified.spacer_element: ✓ Render as flex child: <div className='keyboard-spacer' style={{ height: keyboardSpacerHeightPx }} />
implementation_verified.spacer_css: ✓ flex-shrink: 0; height driven by keyboardSpacerHeightPx state
implementation_verified.no_page_scrollbars: ✓ Terminal wrapper overflow: hidden prevents document scrolling
implementation_verified.no_overlay: ✓ Push-up spacer (DOM occupies space) not overlay-based

qa_findings.desktop_behavior: Desktop (1280x720) shows NO spacer element - keyboard spacer is mobile-only as designed
qa_findings.mobile_open: Mobile viewport (390x844) with keyboard simulation shows spacer with proper height reservation
qa_findings.mobile_close: Spacer returns to 0 height when keyboard closes - smooth height transition via CSS
qa_findings.orientation: Orientation changes properly recalculate spacer - landscape respects reduced absolute viewport
qa_findings.scrollbars: No page-level scrollbars in any scenario - terminal container controls internal scroll only
qa_findings.data_attributes: data-keyboard-spacer-height and data-keyboard-visible attributes exposed for Playwright reads
